features.feature: two huge track units under riveted guard plates, each a breakable part
hull between and over the tracks: sloped prow with the dozer bar and hazard stripes, sponson decks
armoured command bridge at the front, vision slits, sensors
factory hall: sloped walls with ribs, sawtooth roof with skylights, gantry crane, stacks, AC plant, pipes
four twin 120 mm turrets: two on the forward sponsons, two on the raised rear gun deck
twin 35 mm flak mount on the roof
two factory doors in the stern with ramp, hazard frames and warning beacons (the weak rear)
conveyor arm on the right flank, spare-track rack, supply crates, drums
the owner general's colour band round hull, hall and turrets
